snip.t: It arises from the lower fibula (not tibia), passes deep to the extensor retinaculum, is supplied by the deep peroneal nerve, and both dorsiflexes and everts the foot.
snip.s: Anatomy Must-Know — Lower Limb MCQs, Section 3 (Part 3 of 4)

snip.t: The fibula is lateral to the tibia, ossifies from three centres (not five), does provide some origin for flexor digitorum longus, and soleus arises from the upper (not lower) fibula.
snip.s: Anatomy Must-Know — Lower Limb MCQs, Section 3 (Part 3 of 4)
